noeuds.role: Gives the variable a new value (a number, a text, yes / no or a calculation).
Adds the value to the variable (a negative number subtracts). For a text variable, adds the text at the end.
noeuds.exemple: score + 1 for each coin, health - 1 for each hit.

noeuds.nom: Keep a variable between two values
noeuds.role: Keeps the variable (a number) between a minimum and a maximum.
Puts a random number in the variable. random(1, 6) gives a number from 1 to 6.
Puts the object in the inventory (a variable of type Inventory List). It is only added once.
Removes the object from the inventory.
noeuds.exemple: use the key to open the door.

noeuds.role: Follows the True output if the object is in the inventory, False otherwise.
noeuds.exemple: the door only opens if the key is in the inventory.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B, Result object name
noeuds.role: Replaces objects A and B with a copy of the object whose name you type, at A's place. If that model does not exist, nothing changes.
